carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three dominant horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, elongated high-luminance shape is attached to the ventral surface of the left pectoral fin, and the upper lobe of the caudal fin exhibits a dense pattern of small, high-intensity spots.
